title: Seattle-based satellite startup Hubble, which is working to enable global Bluetooth connectivity, raised $200M at a $1.6B valuation, for $300M in total funding (Sana Pashankar/Bloomberg)
summary: Sana Pashankar / Bloomberg: Seattle-based satellite startup Hubble, which is working to enable global Bluetooth connectivity, raised $200M at a $1.6B valuation, for $300M in total funding — Satellite startup Hubble Network raised $200 million in a new funding round, taking the company's valuation to $1.6 billion …
